name: Shadowboxing Hook
steps: Stand in clear space with one foot slightly forward, your knees relaxed and your hands at cheek height.
Pivot lightly on the front foot and trace a short horizontal arc through the air with the bent lead arm.
Return the hand beside your cheek and settle back into your starting stance.
Continue at a steady rhythm, then switch your stance to work the other arm.
tips: Keep the movement clear of people and nearby objects.
Move your front foot and hip together so the knee turns comfortably.
